chunks: Al-Sheikh (may God have mercy on him) informed me, from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from more than one person, from Aban, from a man, from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him):
that he said, regarding a man who dies with a group at sea —
he said: 'He is to be washed (ghusl), shrouded (kafn), the funeral prayer performed over him, weighted down, and cast into the sea.'

key_terms.يُثَقَّلُ: weighted down — a weight attached to the body to ensure it sinks
key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ: funeral prayer performed over him — the obligatory salat al-mayyit
key_terms.يُغَسَّلُ: washed — ritual ghusl (full-body washing) performed on the deceased
key_terms.يُكَفَّنُ: shrouded — the kafn (burial shroud) applied to the deceased

ai.seo_question: What are the Islamic funeral rites for a Muslim who dies at sea according to Shia hadith in al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) rules on the funeral rites for a Muslim who dies at sea: the deceased must receive ghusl, be wrapped in a kafn, and have the funeral prayer performed. Since land burial is impossible, the body is then weighted and cast into the sea. The ruling preserves the full sequence of obligatory rites while accommodating the physical impossibility of earth burial.
word_analysis: he is to be washed (ghusl performed)
he is to be shrouded (kafn applied)
the funeral prayer is performed (over him)
he is to be weighted down
he is to be cast / thrown
